description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'log/show --expand-tabs' functionality. It defines functions to test the expansion of tabs and spaces in git show output, sets up test scenarios, and executes various test cases to validate behavior related to tab and space expansion.

methods.name: count_expand
methods.description: Function that constructs an expected output string with a specified number of spaces and tabs, used to compare against actual git show output.

methods.name: test_expand
methods.description: Function that runs a series of tests to verify tab and space expansion behaviors for different formats and options.
